fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects a program that invoked suspicious DNS queries known from Cobalt Strike beacons
fields.name: Suspicious Cobalt Strike DNS Beaconing - Sysmon
fields.query: event.category="dns" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((event.dns.request contains "aaa.stage." or event.dns.request contains "post.1") or event.dns.request contains ".stage.123456."))
